answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in signal, verified in vertex, and horizon names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 11 submissions per epoch. The attacker spends 217 dollars and 11 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
